description.narrative: Project Objective:To promote mechanisms and good practices of commercial banks and financial investment institutions in providing green investment and credit to agricultural enterprises that implement sound ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) practices.Key Results:Result 1: Increase both the quantity and quality of dialogue between banks and agricultural enterprises regarding green financial investment for ESG-compliant agricultural businesses. These dialogues will be evidence-based and case-specific, aiming to address barriers in mechanisms and green finance practices from banks for agricultural enterprises.Result 2: Enhance awareness and capacity of businesses, related support organizations, and communities on ESG (Environmental - Social - Governance), green agriculture,and green credit.The project targeting primarily agricultural enterprises that wish to invest in and adopt green agriculture practices, banks providing green credit for the green agriculture sector, and relevant government agencies working on improving green credit policies in agriculture. Direct Beneficiaries of the ProjectApproximately 125 agricultural enterprises, cooperatives, agricultural business associations, and civil society organizations working in the agricultural sector.Banks and financial institutions such asAgriBank, BIDV, Techcombank, CitiBank, Shinhan Bank, and other banks, financial institutions, and funding programs related to greenfinance. Indirect Beneficiaries of the ProjectIndirect beneficiaries include customers/clients/service providers of agricultural enterprises, as well as bank clients who benefit from the good practices of agricultural businesses and banks.Project outputs such asdocuments, reports, research findings, and lessons learned can be made available for future reference by relevant stakeholders after the project is completed.

participating-org.narrative:
Research Center of Management and Sustainable Development (MSD) is a Vietnamese non-government organization established under SouthEast Asia Research Association Vietnam # SEARAV, according to the decision number: 53-2017 /Q#-TWH on August 16, 2017.
Mission: Asa Vietnamese non-governmental organization, MSD efforts to act for an enable environment for the development of civil society sector and to promote the rights of marginalized groups, especially children, youth, women and people with disabilities.
Vision: Our vision is a world of justice and equality, where civil society plays as an effective independent actor/ partner with their own rights and the rights of marginalized and vulnerable communities are respected.
Slogan: We create values and achieve local impact in a niche market. We work effectively and efficiently through mutual learning, inspiring and innovative intervention.
Core Values and Principles Equitable partnerships Networking and solidarity Inclusion and People empowerment Good governance Innovative intervention Objectives Empower # to build capacity for CSOs towards development effectiveness Partner # to network CSOs together and with other development actors for robust and effective partnership Enable # to promote enabling environment for civil society to do its work, and to enhance its self-development Intervene # to promote the rights of marginalised groups, especially children, youth, women and people with disabilities
